turns.text: Sam is actually busy tonight, so I'm just going by myself. I'll probably just listen to some music on the drive over.

turns.text: I've been playing a little bit of guitar in the evenings, but climbing has definitely been my main focus lately. Anyway, I should get back to these reports!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good luck with the reports, Leo! Have a great climb tonight and enjoy the rest of your day.
